verdict.rationale: Crossplane is an infrastructure control-plane platform, so built-in AI insights or suggestions, such as AI-assisted troubleshooting of compositions, is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows that its declarative APIs can be consumed by AI agents. That positions AI as an external client, not as an in-product feature that generates insights from the user's data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
